name: quickshell
title: QuickShell
description: Open saved project folders in Windows Terminal and other shells
author: tonythethompson

preferences.name: terminalApplication
preferences.title: Default Terminal App
preferences.description: Terminal application used when a workspace launch uses the QuickShell default.

preferences.name: defaultProfile
preferences.title: Default Profile
preferences.description: Profile name for the default terminal app. Use __default__ for the app default profile.

preferences.name: showRecents
preferences.title: Recent Workspaces
preferences.description: Show recently opened workspaces in Open Workspace.
preferences.label: Show recent workspaces

preferences.name: singleWindowTabs
preferences.title: Multi-command Launch
preferences.description: When supported, open multiple launch commands as tabs in one Windows Terminal window instead of separate windows.
preferences.label: Open multiple commands in one Windows Terminal window

preferences.name: blockDirtyBranchSwitch
preferences.title: Git Branch Gate
preferences.description: Block launch when a target branch is set and the working tree has uncommitted changes.
preferences.label: Block dirty branch switch

commands.name: create-workspace
commands.title: Create Workspace
commands.subtitle: QuickShell
commands.description: Create a new workspace with directory, terminal, and launch commands

commands.name: discover-git-repos
commands.title: Discover Git Repos
commands.subtitle: QuickShell
commands.description: Scan local folders and add git repositories as workspaces

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Manage Workspaces
commands.subtitle: QuickShell
commands.description: Import, export, undo workspace changes, and open extension preferences
